primary_diagnosis: Diabetic kidney disease (proteinuric CKD) with hypertensive nephropathy
clinical_reasoning_summary: The patient’s longstanding type 2 diabetes, resistant hypertension, and proteinuric CKD make diabetic kidney disease the dominant chronic process. A striking creatinine discrepancy indicates an acute kidney injury superimposed on this chronic background, likely precipitated by medication duplication or volume changes. Established atherosclerotic disease and hypertension further modulate risk, while mood symptoms and mild bilirubin elevation are low‑probability contributors.
